name: Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH)
jurisdiction: Statewide Industrial Safety, Factories Act 1948 & Maharashtra Rules 1963

name: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB)
jurisdiction: Environmental Sanctions (Consent to Establish CTE / Consent to Operate CTO)

name: Maharashtra Fire & Life Safety Directorate
jurisdiction: Life Safety, Hydrant Certification & Fire NOC (Act 2006)

name: Maharashtra Industrial Development Corp (MIDC)
jurisdiction: Industrial Land Allotment, Building Plan Sanction & Water Works

name: Office of Labour Commissioner Maharashtra
jurisdiction: Contract Labour (R&A) Act, Shops & Establishments, Mathadi Boards

name: Food and Drug Administration (FDA Maharashtra)
jurisdiction: State / Central Food Manufacturing Licences & Hygiene Audits

name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran)
jurisdiction: HT / LT Industrial Power Substation Load Feasibility & Energization

name: Urban Local Bodies / Pimpri Chinchwad & Pune Municipal Corp
jurisdiction: Trade Licence, Solid Waste Management & Municipal NOC
